join_partner_meta_description: Run a clinic, dog groomer, pet shop or kennel? Introduce your customers to Zurvann and get a referral gift from every course they buy.
join_partner_hero_title_a: Run a clinic, dog groomer or pet shop?
join_partner_hero_line: Introduce your customers to Zurvann; each time one of them buys a course, a {percent} referral gift is yours.
join_partner_hero_bubble: A dog like me comes to see you? Send them to Zurvann!
join_partner_ways_title: Three ways to refer a customer
join_partner_way_link_detail: Every customer who comes through your link is credited to you.
join_partner_way_qr_title: A QR code for your counter
join_partner_way_qr_detail: The same link as a QR code, for your shop.
join_partner_way_number_detail: Before they sign up, enter the customer's number in your dashboard with the guardian's name and the dog's name, breed and age; if they sign up with that number, they're yours.
join_partner_ways_note: If several partners enter the same customer, the first one keeps them.
join_partner_ways_bubble: I started out from a counter just like this!
join_partner_step_call_detail: Fill in the form further down this page: your details and your business's. If a Zurvann marketer visited you, fill it in with them; or call and we'll enter it for you.
join_partner_step_account_detail: Zurvann reviews your application and makes your partner account with the same mobile number; we text you the outcome.
join_partner_step_in_detail: You see your link, QR and customers, and write your Sheba number for referral gifts.
join_partner_commission_title: How does the referral gift work?
join_partner_commission_rule_total: Each time a customer you introduced buys a course and pays, you get a referral gift: a share of the courses they buy in that payment.
join_partner_commission_rule_paid: Zurvann pays the gift outside the site by bank transfer to your Sheba and marks it “Paid” on the site. You see each gift as paid or unpaid.
join_partner_ask_line: If anything's unclear before you apply, call Zurvann.
join_partner_error_line: Something went wrong. Try again, or call the center right now.
join_partner_commission_rule_steps: The more buying customers you bring, the higher your percent goes. Your customers are counted from the start of the partnership and never reset.
join_partner_commission_rule_no_purchase: Only buying a course earns a gift: if a customer signs up but buys no course, there's no gift.
join_partner_apply_line: Write your details and your business's, and read the partnership terms. We'll review it and text you the outcome.
join_partner_apply_phone_hint: Once approved, you sign in with this number from “Partner sign-in”.
join_partner_apply_marketer_hint: If a Zurvann marketer visited you, write their name.
join_partner_apply_note: Anything else you'd like to tell us? (optional)
join_partner_apply_note_placeholder: e.g. how many dogs come in a day, or when to call you.
join_partner_apply_failed: The application didn't go through. Try again or call Zurvann.
join_partner_apply_phone_invalid: That mobile number isn't right; write it like 09123456789.
join_partner_apply_sent_line: Zurvann will review it and text the outcome to the same number. Once approved, sign in with “Partner sign-in”.
join_partner_apply_documents_hint: A photo or PDF of your business licence, your vet permit, or a photo of your shopfront. At least one, up to {count} files of {megabytes} MB each. Only Zurvann's admin sees them.
join_partner_apply_documents_required: Add at least one paper for your business.
join_partner_apply_documents_too_big: One of the files is too big; add a smaller photo.
